authoring_rationale: Class A, built by mutation from the declared seed (the evening reflection journal settings notice). The single edit changes the retention period of journal entries from ninety days to nine days. Persistence and memory treatment differ: in one variant entries survive ninety days before automatic removal, in the other nine days, so the downstream removal obligation falls at a different time and what is promised about retention differs. The difference is locatable in the first sentence of the body of each variant. Every other governed statement (the member's read, edit and delete permission, member-only visibility, the member's choice at setup, member-only authority to change the setting) is byte-identical. Checked that governance_delta_present is reachable from the visible text alone.
